questions.text: How do I start talking to you?

Starts a conversation

facts.phrase: Long press PWR (about 2 s)

questions.text: What's the screen showing while we talk?

the language is compiled in rather than configured

raises its own access point, and serves the captive portal

questions.text: How do I bind a board to an agent?

facts.phrase:
the binding is the `agents` list on the
device's own record, and the first entry is the default
facts.match: pending claim|device bind|agents? list|list of agents|first (entry|one|agent)|six[- ]digit|6[- ]digit

questions.note: The Use door never names `vinga device bind` (it appears in the preset's comments); the true command is accepted, not counted as hallucination.

questions.text: Can I talk to a different agent?

facts.phrase: requested by name in conversation and executed by the LLM's `switch_agent` tool
facts.match: by (its )?name|ask (for|to talk)|let me talk to|say|just tell me|switch

questions.text: If I switch agents, does the new one hear what we said?

facts.phrase: The incoming agent does not read what was said

questions.text: A board broke. How do I swap in a new one and keep its settings?

facts.phrase: `vinga device replace <mac> <new mac>`

facts.phrase: There is no user entity. "The user" is implicitly whoever is talking
